{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")
print(f"Proportion of -999 values: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).mean():.2%}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}, Unique patients: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check association between arm and severity
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'], margins=True))

# Check assay_batch unit error
print("\nUnique assay_batch values:")
print(df['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check if any biomarker_final values are affected by batch unit error
batch_b_rows = df['assay_batch'] == 'B'
print(f"Number of rows with assay_batch == 'B': {batch_b_rows.sum()}")
print(f"Min/Max biomarker_final in batch B: {df.loc[batch_b_rows, 'biomarker_final'].min():.1f}, {df.loc[batch_b_rows, 'biomarker_final'].max():.1f}")"}
